text:
National Coming Out Day is about celebrating the courage it takes to live openly and authentically, as well as supporting those who aren’t able to take that leap yet. Generations of LGBTQIA+ advocates have fought for equality and acceptance, wishing for their own shot at dignity and the American dream.

We’ve come so far in the fight for equal rights, and I’m proud to represent a community that refuses to allow those rights to backslide. Whether it’s a teen struggling to express themselves, or an adult coming out later in life, there’s nothing more American than living your true self, and I won’t stop fighting for that right.

National Coming Out Day is about celebrating the courage it takes to live openly and authentically, as well as supporting those who aren’t able to take that leap yet. Generations of LGBTQIA+ advocates have fought for equality and acceptance, wishing for their own shot at dignity and the American dream.

We’ve come so far in the fight for equal rights, and I’m proud to represent a community that refuses to allow those rights to backslide. Whether it’s a teen struggling to express themselves, or an adult coming out later in life, there’s nothing more American than living your true self, and I won’t stop fighting for that right.
